title: Emotion-aware Dual Cross-Attentive Neural Network with Label Fusion for Stance Detection in Misinformative Social Media Content
reasoning: The paper evaluates stance detection models (including LLMs like Mistral, GPT-3.5, and LLaMa3) using the SemEval-2016 (Task 6A) benchmark, which includes 'Atheism' as a specific target topic. This involves evaluating how models classify viewpoints on a belief-related/religious subject.
